description: Draw up to 4 symbol ideas for the brand with AI: vector, no letters, in its colors. Costs 2 credits per idea, charged when the run starts and refunded for each idea that fails. A batch of 4 costs 8 credits. Answers with the run; each idea arrives as an event.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this call. Send the SAME one again after a lost answer to get the first answer back, with nothing spent twice.
